T: Learn the way of water. Then eat.
D: Jake Sully's family flees the forest and takes shelter with the Metkayina reef clan.
P: Serve the mains when Payakan the outcast tulkun saves Lo'ak.
S: Prawn skewers grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter
Prawns tossed in garlic, chilli, lime and melted butter, grilled 2 minutes a side until charred, served on skewers with lime wedges.
Mango, pineapple and papaya with passionfruit, lime juice and toasted coconut
Mango, pineapple and papaya cut into wedges with halved passionfruit, squeezed with lime and scattered with toasted coconut.
Lo'ak learning to ride an ilu in the kelp

Nori sheets brushed with sesame oil, sprinkled with sesame seeds and salt, toasted in a dry pan until crisp and cut into strips. Brush 8 nori sheets lightly on one side with 2 tbsp sesame oil mixed with 1 tsp honey. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp sesame seeds, a pinch of chilli flakes and flaky salt. Stick 2 sheets together oiled sides out, then toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute a side, or bake at 150C for 8 minutes, until crisp. Cut into strips with scissors and serve straight away.
M: Snapper poached in coconut milk with lemongrass, red chilli and lime
Snapper fillets simmered 10 minutes in coconut milk with lemongrass, chilli and lime, served over steamed rice with fresh herbs.
Jake says it: this family is our fortress.

Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, sliced over a salad of mango, mint and red onion. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh for 1 hour with the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp oil. Grill over high heat 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred and cooked through, then rest. Toss 2 diced mangoes with a thinly sliced red onion, mint, coriander, lime juice and a pinch of salt. Slice the chicken over the salad.
W: Coconut milk set with gelatine in glasses, topped with diced mango
Coconut milk warmed with sugar and set with gelatine in glasses for 4 hours, topped with diced mango and passionfruit.
K: Frozen pineapple, coconut water and coconut cream blended with lime and mint

Frozen pineapple blended with coconut water, coconut cream, lime and mint into a slushy crush, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge. Blend 400g frozen pineapple chunks with 500ml chilled coconut water, 100ml coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime, a few mint leaves and 1 cup ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and finish each with a pineapple wedge and mint sprig.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss and skewer the prawns up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; grill just before serving

steps.text: Soak 8 skewers. Crush the garlic, chop the red chillies, zest a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.
Toss the prawns with garlic, chilli, zest and butter and thread onto skewers.
Grill a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Serve with lime wedges and spoon over any butter left in the pan.

veg.make_ahead: Toss and skewer the haloumi up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill just before serving

steps.text: Soak 8 skewers. Crush the garlic, chop the red chillies, zest a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.
Cut the haloumi into cubes, toss with garlic, chilli, zest and butter and thread onto skewers.
Grill a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Serve with lime wedges and spoon over any butter left in the pan.

Pile onto a platter, squeeze over lime juice and scatter with coconut.

s.note: Prawn skewers grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Thread onto skewers and grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Serve with lime wedges and spoon over any butter left in the pan.

s.note: Mango, pineapple and papaya with passionfruit, lime juice and toasted coconut
s.how: Cut 2 mangoes, half a pineapple and half a papaya into wedges and pile on a platter with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and scatter with toasted shredded coconut. Serve chilled on a hot afternoon by the reef.

m.note: Snapper poached in coconut milk with lemongrass, red chilli and lime
m.how: Bruise 2 lemongrass stalks and simmer in 800ml coconut milk with sliced red chilli for 10 minutes. Add 4 snapper fillets and poach gently for 10 minutes. Squeeze in lime juice and serve over steamed jasmine rice with fresh herbs.

w.note: Coconut milk set with gelatine in glasses, topped with diced mango
w.how: Warm 800ml coconut milk with 100g sugar until dissolved. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in. Pour into glasses and chill for 4 hours until set. Top with diced mango and passionfruit pulp before serving.

d.note: Frozen pineapple, coconut water and coconut cream blended with lime and mint
d.how: Blend 400g frozen pineapple chunks with 500ml chilled coconut water, 100ml coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime, a few mint leaves and 1 cup ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and finish each with a pineapple wedge and mint sprig.
